yields.label: Food
yields.description: Workers in agriculture, forestry and fishing (oil palm, rubber, paddy, fisheries), counted where they live. Workers by industry from DOSM's Labour Force Survey (2021, the latest state table; Census 2020 is its benchmark), by state. DOSM publishes no district split, so a district's figure is its state's workers in each industry shared out by the district's 2020 GDP in the matching sector: an estimate.

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: GDP in constant 2015 ringgit (RM), so figures from different years compare. States and the nation: 2025. Districts and cities: 2020, the latest year DOSM publishes by district (Putrajaya's is inside Kuala Lumpur's). Offshore oil and gas belongs to no state and is only in the national figure.
